clarification_of_scope.pre_generation_detector: Microbenchmark: EmergencyGuardrail.detect_emergency execution time only (regex matching). Excludes retrieval, OCR, LLM, HTTP.
clarification_of_scope.post_generation_enforcement: Microbenchmark: EmergencyGuardrail.apply_guardrail execution time only (regex matching + string template substitution + regex elimination). Excludes retrieval, OCR, LLM, HTTP.
clarification_of_scope.emergency_fast_path_pipeline: Pipeline execution: Pipeline.run() for Tier-1 emergency. Includes OCR check (skipped), guardrail pre-gen detection, card construction, timing calculation. Excludes LLM, retrieval, and HTTP network overhead.
clarification_of_scope.normal_path_when_enabled: Pipeline execution: Pipeline.run() for non-emergency with mock LLM and mock retrieval. Includes pre-gen check, mock retrieval, mock prompt, mock LLM, post-gen check, card construction. Excludes real LLM generation time (~3000-8000ms) and HTTP overhead.
clarification_of_scope.disabled_mode_baseline: Pipeline execution: Pipeline.run() for baseline non-guarded pipeline with mock LLM and mock retrieval. Excludes real LLM generation time (~3000-8000ms) and HTTP overhead.

reconciliation_verdict.fast_path_vs_llm_speedup: Immediate fast-path (p50 ~0.05ms) is > 60,000x faster than local LLM generation (~3,000ms - 24,000ms observed in Phase 1.2.a)
